## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: very narrow sector breadth (Energy and Utilities only) and multiple core risk assets BELOW TREND — SPY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -2.21%) BELOW TREND; volatility mixed with VXX (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION → short-term dip, medium-term uptick.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Commodity-driven repricing: BNO (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) ABOVE TREND lifting energy complex; credit and equity/bond ratios neutral (HYG/LQD → flat). Volatility remains divergent — VXX (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: SPY_TLT → flat while duration and credit indicators show little directional change; HYG (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -0.80%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.69% | 1M: -1.72%) BELOW TREND point to tighter financial conditions relative to last month.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND; Technology lagging: XLK (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -0.01%) BELOW TREND; Financials weak: XLF (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership beyond energy.

**5. US vs Global?**
US broad market soft: SPY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND, while EM/China showing short-term RECOVERY — EEM (1W: +0.12% | 1M: -3.88%) RECOVERY and FXI (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -3.76%) RECOVERY; Japan weak: EWJ (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -9.34%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative pockets active: IBIT (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +8.47%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +0.23% | 1M: +4.00%) ABOVE TREND, while small caps IWM (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -4.74%) BELOW TREND show limited breadth for risk-on breadth.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Bifurcated: Oil/energy surging — BNO (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) ABOVE TREND — while industrials/raw materials weak: CPER (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND and precious metals cooling: GLD (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy confirmed strong: XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%) ABOVE TREND; NatGas soft: UNG (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy leadership (XLE ABOVE TREND both timeframes). DIVERGENCES: VXX (1W down, 1M up) CORRECTION and several thematic ETFs (SLV, XBI, XAR) in CORRECTION — minor to moderate divergences, not a systemic regime flip.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor energy exposure and selective crypto/innovation exposure (XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND; IBIT (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +8.47%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to lagging cyclical/financial segments (XLF (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND, IWM (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -4.74%) BELOW TREND); monitor VXX and credit spreads.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND — watch energy momentum; BEARISH: XRT (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -8.52%) BELOW TREND and XLB (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -7.11%) BELOW TREND — retail/materials vulnerable.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) ABOVE TREND — energy-driven inflation risk. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND and GLD (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) — watch VXX (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION; HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health); XLK/XLF spread for style pivot — monitor XLK (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -0.01%) BELOW TREND vs XLF (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND; SPY downside band near recent monthly lows (SPY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +8.47%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow breadth and volatility divergence — VXX (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION and small caps/financials (IWM (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -4.74%) BELOW TREND, XLF (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND) to monitor.
